I am an old woman in Tigray, and this small plot near the house I will use for something other than the main grain — maybe some vegetables or a little crop for the family pot. The land is only a fifth of a hectare, and the rains here are not generous, so I cannot spend much money on it. I will put the manure from my animals on it, because that is what I always have, and I will use the seed I saved from last year. My sons and daughters-in-law help me when they can, but I do most of the work myself with the hoe.
